summary: generate {description, keywords} for a note's derived text, written to its frontmatter
hints: Generate a description + keywords for one note (source: its .extract.md if it has one, else its own body) and write them to the note's frontmatter — never to the .extract.md, which --reextract rewrites. Idempotent via an enrich_key: hash of (model, text); a plain re-run on unchanged text is a no-op, --reenrich forces. --all sweeps every note lacking a current key, sequentially, under one warm model load. Auto-wired (best-effort) into `files extract` and `bookmark` unless PLAINKEEP_ENRICH=off. Common mistake: expecting meta on the .extract.md — it lives on the shadow/primary note.
